target_customer: Developers building AI shopping experiences and agents, plus brands seeking distribution on AI shopping platforms
problem: Developers building shopping assistants have no structured, current product data; search APIs return articles or stale product pages, and Google and OpenAI keep their product graphs private.
business_model: Usage based API, 1,000 free searches then $7 per 1,000, plus commissions developers earn on sales through affiliate networks
product_category: Product catalog and search API for agentic commerce

founders.name: Alexander Schiff
education: Duke University, computer science and psychology
previous_startups: Co-founded a first startup with George Lawrence at Duke (per company blog)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page and company blog.

founders.name: George Lawrence
education: Duke University, BS in computer science

competitors.name: Exa, Tavily and Bing search APIs
competitors.what: General search APIs developers used to fetch product info
competitors.traction_then: Widely used by AI developers; founders said results were articles rather than structured product data

competitors.name: Semantics3
competitors.what: Former YC product data company with a similar concept

competitors.name: FMTC
competitors.what: Aggregator of merchant product feeds raised by a commenter as a competitor

technical_complexity.rationale: Crawling and matching tens of millions of products across merchants with multimodal models, variant linking and attribute extraction, kept fresh, is hard at scale for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: A large matched catalog compounds and is costly to rebuild, but Shopify's Catalog API and foundation model providers can offer similar data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: By 2026 Shopify's Catalog API and other product data APIs appear in comparison articles. No evidence found of Channel3 being acquired.

market_need_then: Agentic shopping was emerging in 2025 and the founders reported hundreds of developers using the API at launch, building stylist, gifting and shopping assistant apps.

branding.domain_note: Originally used trychannel3.com, which now redirects (301) to channel3.ai.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and developer focused, database of every product on the internet

branding.brand_signature: Database of every product on the internet

rebrands.why: Domain move only; the company name stayed the same

branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN thread with developer replies; AlleyWatch interview in December 2025

brand_strength.rationale: Good developer press at launch but no evidence the name itself drives awareness.

outcome_analysis: Channel3 built a product graph after its founders hit the data gap while building an AI tutor, joined YC in Summer 2025 and raised a $6M seed led by Matrix on 2025-12-10 with hundreds of developers on the API. Agentic commerce timing helps, while platform players such as Shopify are the main competitive threat.
notes: Seed confirmed by the company blog and press (Pulse 2, VCA Online). One tracker reports $7M total, unverified. The Launch HN page showed only relative dates; August 2025 is inferred from the post's reference to Bing's deprecation on 2025-08-13. Founder prior employers and education come from the YC page and company blog. YC page also notes a Backend Engineer opening.
